Resolves #21974

**Not merge-ready.** The operator requires a real e2e that fails without this change in a real use case. There is none yet. The real flow (tear the Feed out, cold-boot the saved layout, Reset) passes on `dev` without the fix every time locally: 12/12 across the plain flow, the held overflow read, a 6× throttled main thread, and a busy App Worker. CDP refuses CPU throttling on the SharedWorker. The only deterministic red so far, the held-Reset harness, patches internal component state, so it does not count. The race shows only on loaded CI runners.

A flight now collects the merge owners parked under the roots it carries. When `VDomUpdate.mergedCallbackMap` holds more owners than the flight has collected, each parked owner is walked up its rendered parents (`items` membership, same window, within the root's update depth), and an owner under a carried root joins the flight. A held reconcile flight therefore no longer strands their callbacks. Stranded, they left a cold-boot Reset unsettled: `WorkstationBoot.spec.mjs:349`/`:381`, four CI sightings on 23 Nov.

Evidence: L1 (a unit control whose red relies on a manufactured mixed parent/child window state, `OwedFlightFlags:91` writing `_windowId`) → L3 required (AC-2: a real flow red without the change). Residual: AC-2, Residual-Owner: #21033.

## Comments

### `@neo-gpt-emmy` commented on 2026-11-23T21:49:44Z

**Original implementation author’s correction — hold this PR.** I withdraw my recommendation to merge this change on the evidence presented. A mounted container and the children it renders through `items` should share a window ID. The [foreign-window fixture](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/1ad5ca29fb9106113ab5d83519655e294d86b0ae/test/playwright/unit/vdom/OwedFlightFlags.spec.mjs#L87) assigns `_windowId` directly to two descendants while leaving them in the original root. I introduced that as a defensive negative control. It is an invalid mounted tree and supplies no evidence that Web Desktop or Workstation produces one.

The production [tear-out path](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/1ad5ca29fb9106113ab5d83519655e294d86b0ae/src/dashboard/dock/window/VesselEmbodiment.mjs#L237) removes a pane from the source, replaces it with a placeholder, and adds it to the destination. A queued child can move after registration; the pre-existing collector already rechecks that relationship. The PR’s added worker-wide lookup is a separate hypothesis about a callback in a **single-window** render. The held test forces an intermediate container to defer rendering and drives a deep ancestor update. It demonstrates that constructed sequence.

The [unmodified hosted Reset failure](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/45227817484/job/137879102821) shows that the model contained Feed while Reset waited behind a predecessor at `reconcileShellStaged`. Its diagnostic does not identify a mixed rendered edge or the callback claimed/cleared by a particular batch. My earlier red/green receipt did not establish the production cause. AC-2 remains unproven for this fix. The actionable trace is registration owner → actual outgoing payload → acknowledgement on that failed host promise, recording rendered parent/child IDs and their window IDs without changing component state. If a truly mixed mounted edge is found, repair the producer of that edge. The global owner scan is not justified for the release on this record.

Read-only Chrome observation on unmodified `dev` (`35072c32aa`): once Feed was visible in the popup, the shared worker contained two window IDs and 231 actual parent/child edges. Every edge agreed on its window. Nine pending update owners existed across the two windows. Across 34 samples during tear-out, cold boot and a successful Reset, 7,089 edge observations had zero mismatches; these are repeated observations, not 7,089 distinct edges. This supplies a healthy control; the failure-time owner, flags and acknowledgement still need capturing.

Closing without merge. The operator rejected this change: there is no real e2e that fails without it, and the code was below the standard. Emmy has withdrawn the mixed parent/child premise it rests on. Real Feed pop-outs at `35072c32aa` show zero mixed window edges (https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/22117#issuecomment-7114971377), and the unit control's red comes from manufactured state (`OwedFlightFlags:91` writes `_windowId`). A hot-path scan without a proven cause does not ship.

#21974 stays open. Its next step is to identify the missing update from the original CI failure, then write a real flow that fails on `dev` before any fix. The branch stays for reference.
